texto.ru: When I got home, there were three messages. Anna said that she was going to be late. My boss said he would call me in the morning. My mother asked if I had eaten. She told me to call her. Tom asked me where I had put his book. He said he needed it for tomorrow. I wrote back and told them that I would answer everything after dinner.
texto.pt: Quando cheguei em casa, havia três mensagens. Anna disse que ia se atrasar. Meu chefe disse que ligaria de manhã. Minha mãe perguntou se eu tinha comido. Ela me disse para ligar para ela. Tom perguntou onde eu tinha colocado o livro dele. Disse que precisava dele para amanhã. Respondi e disse que responderia a tudo depois do jantar.

perguntas.resposta: That she was going to be late.
